name: web-dark-team-carousel-with-greyscale-portraits-and-caption-overlays
title: Black 'Creative Cnippet Members' row of greyscale portraits with name and role overlays and a testimonial below
whatItIs: A black page with a small blue icon tile, a white heading with a brush scribble, a grey line, a horizontal row of tall greyscale portrait cards cropped at the edges with translucent bottom bars carrying names and roles, and below a centred white testimonial with a round avatar, name and role.
whatItMeans: Editorial and calm; monochrome portraits create a unified team look on black.
techniques: Convert all team portraits to greyscale.
Put names in a translucent bar on each photo.
Crop the row at the screen edges.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent strip over the bottom of a photo.
Items cut by the frame to imply scrolling.
A quote with avatar under a section.
